facts: Parties: Oakhurst Systems Ltd (Buyer), Larkspur Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Holloway Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 21 April 2027; Closing is scheduled for 3 June 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,000,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Penrith Systems Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
